notes.title: 1.0.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 
Thank you so much for playing the game and sharing your feedback during launch weekend. We’re already hard at work on our first big post-launch update, but in the meantime, we’re releasing a hotfix to address two major issues that stood out:

[list]
[*] [b]Cross-run progression felt too grindy[/b], which led to repetitive gameplay. To address this, we’ve sped up the leveling process by about [b]37%[/b]. Levels you’ve already unlocked will stay the same, but gaining new levels will now be faster.  
[*] The [b]Crimson Sacrifice[/b] passive was way too strong and outperformed all other builds by a wide margin. While we believe it’s fun to have powerful, “broken” builds to discover and optimize, [b]Crimson Sacrifice[/b] was a clear outlier. It trivialized the game and made other builds irrelevant. To fix this, we’ve made the card [b]Unique[/b], which keeps the identity of the build intact while making it more balanced and comparable to others.
[/list]
Thank you again for your support — and have fun in the game!
